name: High Desert
pitch: A web player and 24/7 live station for the Art Bell radio archive, streaming from archive.org with a self-hosted outage mirror.

audience.analyticsSource: self-hosted: the site's own aggregate stats in Postgres (/api/stats/*), read by sang3r.com through /api/stats/export
audience.searchConsole: verified Domain property (DNS TXT), sitemap submitted 2026-10-15

rules: /root/High-Desert is production: never npm install/ci there; dependency work in a worktree
Deploy only with bash scripts/deploy.sh (builds into .next-staging, verifies, rolls back)
Never rm -rf .next or node_modules in the live tree
Checks run on the VPS through heavy, never on GitHub Actions
No third-party scripts, analytics or hosted services; no runtime AI
No em dashes in user-facing copy
Never store an IP address; per-person rules key on the caller cookie
No unattended destructive writes to a visitor's IndexedDB library
Background units stay under 10% CPU (highdesert-mutations exempt)
Add a mutation to scripts/mutate-check.mjs with every new test
